messages:
lee (AE): Heads up 1 NetGuard (large regional bank) wants a 2-week POC. Scope: SSO (Okta + Azure AD), SCIM provisioning (delta + bulk), strict RBAC (group->role + attribute-based grants), domain isolation (per-tenant DNS proof), SCIM token rotation and SCIM rate guarantees for 200k users. They also asked for short procurement note: hosted eval vs dedicated commit. Can we confirm technical constraints and quick pricing guidance?

ana (SE): @lee we support SAML 2.0, signed & encrypted assertions (Okta/Azure/Ping tested). We can map SAML attributes to internal subject_id and a roles claim. SLOs: SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows supported; single logout (SLO) available but depends on IdP behavior.

ana (SE): SCIM details: RFC7644 compliant. Delta sync via ETag + If-Match for safety. PATCH supported for partial updates; PUT is supported for full replace. Default per-tenant rate limit: 15 req/s; burstable on Dedicated up to configurable limits. For 200k users recommend Bulk + paged imports for initial seeding, then delta for ongoing changes.

ben (Solutions): For RBAC, we recommend mapping SCIM groups to roles using group.externalId. We also support attribute-based role binding (e.g., dept=payments -> role:payments-engineer). You can bind multiple groups to a single role and set precedence.

rita (Security): A few security asks from their questionnaire: 1) KMS support for Customer Managed Keys, 2) SCIM token rotation cadence and how revocation works, 3) audit log retention and access controls, 4) proof of domain ownership flow.

ana (SE): Quick answers: 1) CMK supported in Dedicated and Private (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP CMEK available depending on deployment). 2) SCIM tokens are bearer tokens; we support short-lived tokens (recommended rotate every 30 days) and provide an API to revoke tokens immediately. 3) Audit logs capture authentication events, SCIM payloads, and admin actions. Default retention 90 days, upgradeable to 1 year on enterprise add-on.

ben (Solutions): Domain proofing: DNS TXT is preferred. We also support email verification to WHOIS/admin, but enterprise tenants should use TXT. We persist domain->tenant binding; if they decommission a domain it requires support + re-verification to avoid hijack. We can also restrict login origins by domain.

lee (AE): Procurement wants a 1-paragraph comparison: hosted eval vs dedicated commit, focusing on SLAs, data isolation, KMS, and pricing ballpark. Can someone draft quickly?

ben (Solutions): Draft: "Hosted eval: fastest route for feature validation; shared-hosting but tenant logical isolation; limited CMK support; no SLA beyond best-effort during eval; usage-based pricing (per token and provisioning usage). Dedicated commit: isolated capacity with VPC/VPN, full CMK support, configurable rate limits and audit retention, SLA-backed availability; committed monthly/annual pricing (typical starts $20k-30k/mo depending on requested throughput and storage)."

rita (Security): Addendum: Dedicated includes access control for audit logs and SOC2 AOC available under NDA. Note: Private (on-prem/VPC) adds the option for air-gapped installs but is longer lead time.

lee (AE): Great, I'll paste that to procurement. NetGuard also asked about SCIM deletion behavior (soft-delete TTL) and whether we keep historical records for 30/60/90 days.

ana (SE): We implement soft-delete for Users by default (30 days retention) to allow restoration. Admins can request hard-delete via API; hard-delete requests are logged and require an auth workflow. SCIM DELETE will soft-delete unless hard-delete header provided and account meets policy. We can adjust retention per customer on Dedicated.

ben (Solutions): They also want a sample SCIM PATCH + ETag example for their IdP team to validate.

ana (SE): Sample (PATCH with If-Match):

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/5f2a" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "If-Match: \"e2a1b5\"" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"name.familyName","value":"Nguyen"}]}'
```

Include If-Match to ensure you don't clobber concurrent updates. For large changes recommend Bulk endpoint.

deploy-bot: Created POC cluster 'netguard-poc-0426' in us-west-2, namespace netguard-0426. SCIM base URL and temporary SCIM token delivered to lee via DM.

rita (Security): Also flagging default TLS minimum: we require TLS 1.2+ and recommend TLS1.3. We retain minimal PII in our platform: email, name, role, employee_id (optional). Any logs containing PII are redacted in exported reports; raw SCIM payloads accessible to admins only.

lee (AE): NetGuard legal wants a tiny dataflow sketch and list of PII touch points. @ben can you produce a simple diagram text and I9ll attach?

ben (Solutions): Text diagram: "IdP (Okta) -> SAML handshake -> Redwood Auth (token issuance) -> SCIM provisioning API called by IdP/system -> Redwood runtime (models & routing) [no model-side PII stored beyond ephemeral cache] -> Audit logs / storage (encrypted KMS). PII touches: IdP assertion (email, name), SCIM payload (employee_id, email), audit logs."

ben (Solutions): I'll also include a short note: "We do not persist user passwords; authentication always delegated to IdP. SCIM tokens are stored encrypted and rotated on request."

rita (Security): I'll complete the security questionnaire answers and flag anything requiring legal review (AOC, DPA).

lee (AE): Schedule: kickoff Wed 9am PT. I'll ask NetGuard to upload IdP metadata and a sample CSV for bulk import pre-seed. Everyone OK with that plan?

ana (SE): Yup. I'll prepare a small test harness and a sample bulk JSON.

ben (Solutions): I'll finish the procurement paragraph and attach to the kickoff invite.

rita (Security): I'll attach the security answers and the AOC request steps.

lee (AE): Thanks team. I'll follow up in this thread after kickoff with any blockers or additional asks.
